theses.subject: Tech Hardware & Semis
theses.thesis: Tech Hardware & Semis is the highest-ranked eligible theme in a territory where the absolute-trend gate is the only validated edge. It trades with trend character (hurst_tag trend, breadth 0.333) and a durability_bar (0.58) above the Banks headline, so it is staying-power eligible — but relative momentum rank (6 of 17, score 0.518) is a focus lens, not alpha. The call is to avoid fresh exposure here rather than to chase it: the trend gate argues for not being short drawdowns, but no leg argues for actively owning it into a non-directional rotation.
